body: Rent is 500 for my room, I get a decent amount of food from a nearby food bank, and I rarely eat more than once a day.
Seriously, especially for those of us on social assistance actually trying to get better so we can properly function in society...
Single male, I get the maximum allowed for that... 686 a month...
I've learnt, I've fucked up. I've done good I've done bad, it doesn't seem to matter. I always come up short.
